The '''Red Light District''' is a district of [[Portland]], [[Liberty City (3D Universe)|Liberty City]]. It appears in {{III}}, {{A}}, {{LCS}} and the {{SA}} short film "[[The Introduction]]". In ''GTA Advance'', it is simply called '''Red Light'''. The district is bordered by [[Hepburn Heights]] to the north, [[Saint Mark's]] to the east, [[Chinatown (GTA III)|Chinatown]] to the south and an unspecified body of water to the west.

==Description==
As implied, the Red Light District is the {{WP|red-light district}} of Liberty City, housing many of the city's seedy businesses, including strip clubs, pornography stores and prostitution. The district's pedestrians are characterized by a large proportion of [[prostitutes]], and is the only area where [[pimp]]s, easily spotted by their purple jackets and hats, can be found.

The district is busy during all 24 hours of the day, although the player sees the pimps and hookers more at night. Prostitutes can be used to increase health in exchange for cash.

Whilst the district is known for its adult businesses, the western and eastern edges of the district do not appear to share this character, appearing more generic. The western edge of the district occupies part of Portland's waterfront promenade, while the eastern edge bordering Saint Mark's consists of several large buildings, including a large gray skyscraper with an unfurnished interior and scaffolding.

==Influence==
Red Light District is based on {{WP|The Block, Baltimore|The Block}} in {{WP|Baltimore}} and {{WP|42nd Street (Manhattan)|42nd Street}} in {{WP|Manhattan}}, {{WP|New York City}} during the 1970's and 1980's.

==History==
===''Grand Theft Auto III''===
As of [[2001]], the setting of ''GTA III'', the [[Leone Crime Family]] has strong control over this region. There are many strip clubs, adult stores, pimps, and prostitutes. [[Luigi's Sex Club 7]], a Leone-controlled adult business is a popular place for trance music parties, according to [[Lips 106]].

During the events of ''GTA III'', [[Claude]] and [[8-Ball]] escaped to a small apartment in Red Light District after the attacks on [[Callahan Bridge]], and it becomes Claude's [[Portland Safehouse (GTA III)|safehouse]] for the rest of the game.

===''Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories''===
In [[1998]], the setting of ''GTA Liberty City Stories'', it is primarily under [[Sindacco Crime Family]] control, as it has many fronts located in the district including Sex Club 7, which at the time was known as [[Paulie's Revue Bar]]. The Sindaccos and the Leone Family would later fight over control of the district, which would later on be controlled by the Leone Family, as the Sindaccos were later wiped out of the city.
